rationale: F12 (master review 2026-09-30), SECOND HALF and the residual shapes. vue/named-contract pins the script-setup binding and the contract EDGE; this one pins what that fixture could not reach. (a) The Options API hoist: `props: optionProps` / `emits: optionEmits` name a declaration declared in the same file, and extracted NOTHING before F12 — 14 of the corpus files that write `props:` and no `emits:` at all extracted no contract. (b) `defineProps(castProps as const)` — a cast wrapper around a binding, which the identifier test rejected. (c) `defineEmits([LOCAL_EVENT])` — an array of constant REFERENCES rather than string literals; the event name lives in the constant's own declaration, so it is named the way any other declaration is. (d) `defineProps<LeftProps & { rightB: number }>` — a COMPOUND type argument, where the first named operand is the declaration and the inline operand is already read by the generic walk. (e) `defineEmits<Wrapped>()` for a same-file type alias. Every row below is red on the pre-fix analyzer. `from` note: this component declares a `name:` option, so since F8 the ONE Class symbol is named `NamedContractOptions` and every component-owned edge sources it — not the file stem `options-named-contract`.
